design_changes: G2 L5 loads from rear, not a too-thin front cap.
Independent orthogonal guide-rod pairs and orthogonal thick carriage arms avoid traversing fixed supports and mutual collisions.
Follower positions moved to G2+48/G3+50 mm after detailed guide and journal clearance review.
G4 L9 cell removed: one-piece body, L9 front loads, L10 rear loads; G3 structural web enlarged to5mm.
New L12/L13 OD38 rim contact; original prescription and source STEP unchanged.
warnings: Only five source configurations; interpolated positions are not optical performance validation.
Fixed G4 uses source configuration1 coordinates; other source configurations vary cumulatively by up to0.002mm. This normalization is explicit, not an optical correction.
Rim/contact bands, nominal screw threads, fits and centering remain demo assumptions; production preload, tolerance and ray clearance require qualification.
Source STEP sampled edge geometry differs from nominal circular prescription; model uses labelled prescription reference solids, not a claimed exact STEP transfer.
